targets.query:
from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: -1m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpu" and r._field == "usage_idle" and r["cpu"] == "cpu-total")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: 100.0 - r._value}))
  |> last()

from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: -1m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "temp" and r._field == "temp")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: -1m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mem" and r._field == "used_percent")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: -1m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "rapl_power" and r._field == "power_w")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: -1m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gpu_engine_usage" and r._field == "usage" and r["engine"] == "rcs")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: -1m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "npu" and r._field == "utilization")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpu" and r._field == "usage_user" and r["cpu"] == "cpu-total")
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "user")

from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpu" and r._field == "usage_system" and r["cpu"] == "cpu-total")
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "system")
